title: Design of an Open-Source, Low-Cost Bioink and Food Melt Extrusion 3D Printer
protocol: Gather acrylic parts 1–9 and place them together into the configuration shown in Figure 3A.
Check figure labels to ensure each piece is located correctly.
Secure with M3 screws and nuts in the configuration shown in Figure 3C using an M3 Allen key.
Place the M10 threaded rod through the purpose-made holes in acrylic members 6, 8, and 10.
Secure them with M10 washers and nuts as shown in Figure 3B,D.
Tighten with a variable spanner.
Secure two shaft holders to both the back panel and front panel using M2 screws and Allen key.
Secure the stepper motor holder to the back panel using M3 screws and Allen key.
Secure the stepper motor to the stepper motor holder using M3 screws and Allen key.
Secure the belt idler to the front panel using M3 screws and Allen key.
Place the printing bed sub-assembly into the frame by matching up each end of an 8 mm shaft to a shaft holder.
Loosen the M12 washers on the front panel if necessary to place the printing bed sub-assembly into the frame.
Screw the idler to the belt idler using an M3 screw.
Secure the idler toothed to the stepper motor by tightening the M2 grub screw with the M2 Allen key.
Slide the belt around the idler and idler toothed, then into the belt clamp to produce tension in the belt.
Tighten the belt clamp with the M3 Allen key.
Place the brass nut inside of the nut holder and secure it to the x-axis pillow left using M3 screws and Allen key.
Secure the pillow block onto the x-axis pillow left using M4 screws and Allen key.
Secure the x-axis idler 1 to the x-axis pillow left using M3 screws and Allen key.
Align the center holes of the idler, x-axis idler 1, and x-axis Idler 2.
Secure the aligned parts using M3 screws and Allen key.
Assemble the right side of the x-axis sub-assembly according to instructions.
Place the brass nut inside of the nut holder and secure it to the x-axis pillow right using M3 screws and Allen key.
Secure the pillow block onto the x-axis pillow right using M4 screws and Allen key.
Secure the x-axis right to the x-axis pillow right using M3 screws and Allen key.
Secure the stepper motor to the x-axis right using M3 screws and Allen key.
Thread each of the threaded rods into each of the brass nuts according to instructions.
Slide two 8 mm shafts vertically into each of the pillow blocks.
Slide two 8 mm shafts horizontally into each of the pillow blocks.
Secure two shaft holders (3DP 2) to the top panel (acrylic part 2) and electronics enclosure top (acrylic part 5) using M2 screws and Allen key.
Secure pillow block bearings (15) onto the top panel (acrylic part 2) using M3 screws and Allen key.
Secure stepper motors (11) onto the electronics enclosure top (acrylic part 5) using M3 screws and Allen key.
Tighten the lower grub screw over the shafts of the stepper motors (11) with an M2 Allen key to secure the coupler (16).
Remove the top panel (acrylic part 2) temporarily if necessary for inserting the x-axis sub-assembly into the frame.
Align and insert the vertical 8 mm shafts of the x-axis sub-assembly with the shaft holder (3DP 2).
Tighten using M2 screws and Allen key to secure the x-axis sub-assembly in place.
Secure the threaded rod (18) into the other end of the coupler (16) by tightening the upper grub screw with an M2 Allen key.
Secure the two pillow blocks onto the extruder backplate using the M4 screws and Allen key.
Secure the extruder belt clamp onto the extruder backplate between the pillows blocks using the M3 screws and Allen key.
Secure the extruder backplate to the extruder motor holder using M3 hex screws and Allen key.
Secure two stepper motors onto the extruder motor holder using M3 hex screws and Allen key.
Tighten the lower grub screw on the couplers over the shafts of the stepper motors with an M2 Allen key.
Tighten the upper grub screw to secure the threaded screw within the couplers.
Slide the heating jacket or silicone heater into the extruder motor holder according to Figure 9B.
Secure the brass nuts inside plunger lock 1 using M3 screws and Allen key.
Mount the extrusion head onto the x-axis according to Figure 9A.
Slide the 8 mm shafts found on the x-axis into the pillow blocks on the extruder head.
Wrap the drive belt through the idler located on the left and right x-axis assemblies.
Secure the drive belt in the extruder belt clamp using M3 hex screws and Allen key.
Mount the Arduino into acrylic part 7 with M3 hex screws.
Insert a ramps board on top of the Arduino board, oriented as shown in the figure with the USB plug facing acrylic part 6.
Mount the DC power supply jack in acrylic part 6 and connect it to the power supply.
Connect the motor controllers to the respective pins.
Connect the stepper motors to the respective pins.
Connect the end stops to the respective pins.
Connect the heater to the respective pins.
Connect the thermocouple to the respective pins.
Download firmware from marlinfw.org.
Install repetier software.
Replace .configuration file in the firmware found on thingiverse.com.
Set baud rate to 115200 in repetier settings.
Connect to the printer using repetier.
Navigate to Manual Control in repetier.
Move the printing bed manually.
Set the temperature using manual control.
Load a 2 mL syringe with desired material.
Insert the syringe into plunger lock 1.
Insert the syringe into the heating jacket while carefully turning the threaded screws.
Move the printing head left and right then up and down to check for consistent distance between the bed and syringe nozzle.
Slide a piece of paper between the bed and syringe nozzle to feel the friction.
Use the M3 Allen key to adjust the bed level if necessary.
Navigate to the Manual Control tab in repetier.
Set the temperature to the desired level.
